sub_industry: 通用科技/硬科技/软件平台
current_cycle_state: Generic fallback only. Use when no more precise sub-industry anchor exists, and create a dedicated anchor if valuation sensitivity is high.

primary_anchor.reason: Technology companies differ too much for a single anchor; classify into cyclical technology, hard-tech equipment, platform R&D, SaaS/software, biotech, or mature technology leader.

secondary_anchors.reason: Useful for loss-making or margin-transition companies when revenue quality and gross margin path are credible.
Useful when current profits are distorted but normalized margin can be defended.
Useful when mature business, early-stage options, investments, and net cash need separate treatment.

weak_or_floor_anchors.reason: Book value rarely captures IP, customer validation, and software-like economics, but can reveal downside asset support.

disabled_anchors.reason: Not robust across technology companies with different maturity, margin, and R&D profiles.

anchor_switch_rationale: Use this only as a bridge to a more precise sub-industry anchor. The first valuation step must classify the technology business model.
valid_when: the report explicitly creates a valuation-method bridge and marks lower confidence
peer comparison supports the chosen temporary anchor
invalid_when: valuation depends heavily on a specific cycle, policy, pipeline, or platform metric
the report can access current sub-industry evidence but does not update the anchor

sources.name: Current peer multiples and company disclosures are required before use

analyst_notes: Do not rely on this fallback for final high-conviction valuation. Create or update a dedicated anchor whenever possible.
